column1: # DIGITISED from Hughes et al. 2022 Brain Stimul Fig 2B (PMID 35671947, PMC10308851 author manuscript image nihms-1908014-f0002.jpg, 691x1050 px). Median normalised slider intensity across 10 electrodes per burst paradigm (100 Hz, 60 uA, 50% duty, 60 s). Calibration: x ticks 0..60 s at px 86.5..630.5 (9.07 px/s); y ticks 1.0@273.5, 0.2@495.5 px (277.5 px per unit). Method: per 1-s column (3 px wide) median row of pixels within RGB distance 45 of line colour. Resolution ~0.004 units, ~0.11 s. NA = line occluded by another line; 1.0_occluded = hidden under the blue line at value 1.0 (visible in figure); NA_legend = legend region. Slider has 1-2 s motor lag (paper).
